_doc: AC08 (Контейнер НКУ) VPM texture sets, KPP1 recipe (jobs/KPP1/scripts/vpm_textures.json). Gate 1 approved by Artem 2026-10-22 (#565 comment: «Принимаю»): ID2 sandwich panels RAL 5015, ID3 door RAL 7004, mixed ID1 = roof RAL 7004 + frame RAL 7004 + perimeter drop below ±0.000 in the wall colour; solid colours without joints (panel module not dimensioned in the DWG). SUPERSEDED for panels by Artem 2026-10-22 on the pilot renders: «Не вижу швов на панелях ... такой же тексель, как в VPM КПП ... в VPM и NPM» + «ниже ±0.000 без швов»: ID2 = KPP Cassette_RAL5015 recipe (module 0.6 x 0.55 m, 8 mm joints, same noise/recess/roughness), joint rows start at ±0.000 and columns at each facade's left corner; the drop below ±0.000 stays the plain KPP 5015 colour. Geometry stays unchanged (Artem 2026-10-22), so the 4.86 m panel faces cannot fit KPP's 4.096 m tile: S = 5.12 m per 4096 tile = 800 px/m (KPP 1000 px/m; band 512..1706), pattern size in metres identical to KPP. RGB = exact KPP tiles (maps_kpp T_Kpp_1_Diffuse_1.1013 = RAL 5015, .1010 = RAL 7004, pixel-verified in jobs/TEC26-OKS/AC08/MATERIALS.md); roughness/metallic = the KPP proposals of the same finishes. Placeholders: 256 px single colour (reg p.31 §3, density-exempt reg p.31-32 §6.1), as KPP 1010/1013. Address Nku_1 is a placeholder token (address/coordinates deferred as for KPP).

1.why: mixed ID: roof + frame RAL 7004; faces entirely at or below ±0.000 (perimeter drop) take the wall colour (Artem 2026-10-22)

2.why: sandwich panels RAL 5015 (DWG legend 1395) with KPP VPM joints (Artem 2026-10-22)
